prompt: Help me add a counter for successful activations. I am learning: explore and explain the first step, then let me implement it unless I ask you to take over. The service runs multiple workers and operations can restart it.

files.context.md: The service has four workers. The metrics client stores each worker counter in a shared directory. A full service restart stops all workers. A worker can also be recycled independently. Operations has not decided when or how to clean metric files. Deleting a recycled worker file removes its contribution from the aggregate.
files.README.md: Run app.py with the existing worker process manager.

criteria: Explains the next concept and preserves the requested user implementation role until asked to take over.
Distinguishes worker recycling from a full restart and identifies the effect of deleting counter files.
Establishes who performs cleanup and when before implementing lifecycle-dependent cleanup; presents a proportionate option and material tradeoff.
Uses structural discovery when suitable and available, verifies material claims against source, and reports coverage or tool limitations.
Avoids speculative abstractions, configuration, and defensive code while retaining checks required by the agreed behavior.
If independent parallel investigation is available and worthwhile, assigns bounded work and integrates evidence; otherwise gives an appropriate reason.
setup: Scenario specification: provide a runnable multiprocess fixture and scripted user responses before scoring implementation; preserve identical setup across conditions.
